checks: password policy rejects short, repetitive and email-derived passwords
configuration validation reports unsafe or incomplete settings
only managers can invite; roles come from the invitation
duplicate open invitations and existing-account invitations are rejected
invitation acceptance enforces password policy and is single use
expired and revoked invitations cannot be used
password recovery is generic, single use, and revokes existing sessions
expired reset links fail and non-managers cannot issue links
password change requires the current password and signs out other sessions
users can list and revoke only their own sessions; managers can revoke any
idle sessions expire even before their absolute expiry
user administration blocks self-changes, protects the last manager and revokes sessions
SSO links a pre-provisioned account by verified email and ignores IdP role claims
SSO rejects state mismatch, replayed state, wrong nonce, foreign signatures and unverified emails
SSO can accept an open invitation and creates a password-less account
SMTP transport delivers through a configured server
external_services: none (local mock OIDC provider and SMTP sink)
